arabic text:
Jahan pe Zehra ka Ghar Luta Hai
--- Nahi Qayamat Se Kam ye Manzar
Kamar ko Thame Khare Hain sarwar
Sina Kaleje mein Khaaye Akbar Tarap Raha hai
english translation text:
This is Karbala, submerged in blood, where Zahra's
home was plundered. This scene is no less
than Judgement Day: Sarwar stands holding his back,
while Akbar writhes with a spear in his heart.

arabic text: Wo Teer Jisne Gale pe Khaya\nJo Teer Khakar Bhi Muskuraya\nJahan Wo Seene pe Apne Baba Kay So Raha hai
english translation text: Here lies the one whose throat received the arrow,\nwho smiled even after being struck,\nand now sleeps upon his father's chest.

arabic text: Yaheen Hassan ki Miti Nishani\nYaheen pe Farwa ki Godh Ujri\nYahan pe Qasim ka Tukre Tukre Badan Hua Hai
english translation text: Here Hasan's keepsake was erased;\nhere Farwa's lap was emptied;\nhere Qasim's body was torn into pieces.

arabic text: Baha Jo Mashk e Wafa se Paani\nRahi Na Sanson mein Phir Rawani\nBaghair Bazoo Zameen pe Ghazi Jahan Gira Hai
english translation text: When the water poured from the water-skin of loyalty,\nlife itself left his breaths.\nHere Ghazi fell to the ground without arms.

arabic text: Jahan pe Dekha Gaya Ye Manzar\nRawan hai Zalim ka Haaye Khanjar\nGale pe Bete Kay Maan Ne Apna Gala Rakha hai
english translation text: Here this scene was witnessed:\nthe tyrant's dagger continued to move,\nwhile a mother placed her own neck upon her son's throat.

arabic text: Bhara Hai Teeron Se Sheh ka Seena\nKahan pe Soye gi ab Sakina\nJahan pe Beti se Baap Haaye Juda Hua hai
english translation text: The King's chest is filled with arrows.\nWhere will Sakina now sleep?\nHere a daughter was separated from her father.

arabic text: Kareem O Zeeshan Hai Haqiqat\nHai Karbala hi Zameen Pe Jannat\nJahan Pe Jaane Ko Har Hussaini Tarap Raha hai
english translation text: O Karim and Zeeshan, this is the truth:\nKarbala itself is Paradise upon earth,\nthe place every Hussaini longs to visit.
